body.name: admissible cohort loading-mean class
body.construction: \(\mathfrak M_{\lambda}(H)=\{m=(m_c)_{c=1}^C\in(\mathbb R^2)^C:\text{ for every }c\in[C]\text{ there is a probability law }F_c\text{ on }\mathbb R^2\text{ with }\mathbb E_{F_c}[\lambda]=m_c,\ \operatorname{Cov}_{F_c}(\lambda)=H_c,\text{ and }\mathbb E_{F_c}\|\lambda\|^{4+\delta}\le M_{\mathrm{mom}}\}\).
